references.text: The description of the inheritance of Judah from which the tribe of Simeon received their portion, since the territory of Judah was too large for them.
The preceding text listing the cities that the tribe of Simeon received within the inheritance of Judah.
Jacob's prophecy that Simeon would be scattered in Israel, fulfilled by their receiving an inheritance within the territory of Judah.
The census shows that the tribe of Simeon was small in number, explaining why they received a smaller area within the inheritance of Judah.
The descendants of Simeon and their settlements, confirming that they lived within the territory of Judah.
